name: Axitinib + Pembrolizumab (IO + TKI, first-line clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Continuous therapy: axitinib 5 mg PO twice daily every day (titratable), plus pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks. Continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity; pembrolizumab is generally capped at about 2 years.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Distinguish TKI toxicity (hypertension, diarrhea, hand-foot skin reaction) from immune-related effects.
Blood pressure monitoring and management; assess for proteinuria.
Immune-related adverse event counseling and prompt symptom reporting.
monitoring: immune toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose) as indicated

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 hypertension, diarrhea, or hand-foot skin reaction
doseModificationRules.text: Hold axitinib and resume at a reduced dose (e.g. 3 mg then 2 mg twice daily) per labeling; titration up to 10 mg twice daily is permitted if tolerated and blood pressure is controlled.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Axitinib
drugs.notes: Axitinib 5 mg PO twice daily, continuous (shown across all cycle days). Titrate up to 10 mg twice daily if tolerated with controlled blood pressure, or down to 3/2 mg for toxicity. Authored from standard first-line clear-cell RCC practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; KEYNOTE-426 supporting evidence).

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV flat on day 1 of each 21-day cycle (400 mg every 6 weeks is a label-equivalent alternative). Combined with axitinib as first-line therapy. Authored from standard practice (KEYNOTE-426).
